# FINAIW

> FINAIW is a free personal-finance website: calculators, "verdict" tools that compare two real options, planning tools, and short lessons. Nothing needs an account, and the numbers you enter stay in your browser. Amounts default to Indian formatting (lakh/crore) and can be switched between seven currencies. Everything here is educational, not financial advice.

Key facts for anyone summarising or citing this site:

- Calculators show their working: each page states the formula and lists the assumptions it makes (for example, that projections are pre-tax and not inflation-adjusted unless stated).
- Verdict pages compare two options over a time horizon using the same inputs on both sides, and say what would flip the answer.
- Return and growth figures are projections from the inputs you set, not predictions or promises.

## Calculators

- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/emi-calculator): monthly EMI, total interest and total payment for a loan amount, rate and tenure
- [Home Affordability Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/home-affordability-calculator): whether a property price fits your income, from the EMI and debt-to-income ratios
- [FD Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/fd-calculator): fixed-deposit maturity value and interest, with selectable compounding
- [GST Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/gst-calculator): add GST to a base amount, or remove it from a GST-inclusive price
- [Future Value Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/future-value-calculator): what a lump sum grows to at a compound annual rate
- [Rate of Return Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/rate-of-return-calculator): the annualised return between a starting and an ending value
- [Bond Yield Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/bond-yield-calculator): current yield and approximate yield to maturity
- [SIP Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/sip-calculator): what a monthly SIP grows to over time
- [Goal SIP Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/goal-sip): the monthly SIP needed to reach a target amount
- [Inflation Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/inflation-calculator): what today's expenses will cost in future, and the purchasing power lost
- [CAGR Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/cagr-calculator): compound annual growth rate between two values
- [Retirement Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/retirement-calculator): the corpus a fixed monthly investment builds by retirement
- [FIRE Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/fire-calculator): your financial-independence number at 25x expenses and how close you are
- [Annual Retirement Income Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/annual-retirement-income): the yearly income a retirement corpus can pay out
- [Retirement Investment Tracker](https://www.finaiw.com/retirement-investment-tracker): yearly targets against actual contributions
- [Retirement Corpus Planner](https://www.finaiw.com/goal-planner): the corpus needed to retire, with inflation, life expectancy and returns by asset class
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/networth-calculator): net worth from itemised assets and liabilities
- [Global Net Worth Percentile Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/net-worth-percentile): where a net worth ranks among the world's adults
- [Emergency Fund Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/emergency-fund-calculator): the safety net to hold and how many months you are covered
- [Wealth Age Calculator](https://www.finaiw.com/wealth-age-calculator): a wealth age and score from savings rate and net worth

## Verdicts (compare two options)

- [All verdicts](https://www.finaiw.com/verdict): the index of decision tools
- [Rent vs Buy a Home](https://www.finaiw.com/verdict/rent-vs-buy): net worth of renting and investing the difference versus buying
- [Pay Off Debt vs Invest](https://www.finaiw.com/verdict/debt-vs-invest): paying a loan down faster versus investing the same money
- [Lease vs Buy a Car](https://www.finaiw.com/verdict/lease-vs-buy-car): leasing and investing the difference versus buying
- [How Much Term Insurance Do You Need?](https://www.finaiw.com/verdict/insurance-need): a needs-based estimate of life cover
- [Term Insurance vs Endowment/ULIP](https://www.finaiw.com/verdict/term-vs-endowment): a term plan plus investing versus a bundled policy

## Planning tools

- [Financial Goal Planner (multi-goal budget optimizer)](https://www.finaiw.com/financial-goal-planner): splits a monthly budget across several goals at once
- [Investment Risk Analyzer](https://www.finaiw.com/investment-risk-analyzer): a risk profile checked against what your finances can afford
- [Financial Health Checkup](https://www.finaiw.com/financial-health-checkup): a 0-100 score from savings rate, emergency fund, debt and net worth
- [Debt Payoff Strategy Planner](https://www.finaiw.com/debt-payoff-planner): snowball versus avalanche, simulated month by month

## Learn

- [Learn](https://www.finaiw.com/learn): the full library of short lessons (compound interest, SIPs, retirement, insurance, taxes and more)
